text:
Rina: URGENT: sushi box stolen from the kitchen counter. suspect: Miso. pic: https://files.redwood.ai/uploads/miso-sushi-heist.jpg
Omar: that is not a corgi, that is a small, judgmental loaf of bread 602
Cal: confirmed appetite of a tiny vacuum cleaner. anyone else missing a roll?
Tia: i put my spicy tuna in a labelled container 92f
Rina: label says RINA - SPICY. now says RINA - SPICIER (by Miso)
Omar: Miso is currently performing ceremonial sniffing of the empty box like it's forensic evidence
PetBot: Incident logged: "Kitchen Snack Theft" assigned to @officecare. severity: low, cuteness: maximum
Cal: we can fine him in belly rubs and treats. proposal: "one treat per stolen item" policy?
Tia: vote: :thumbsup: agree / :thumbsdown: no - 4 votes yes, 0 votes no
Rina: will accept payment in sashimi and hugs. also bonus photo: https://files.redwood.ai/uploads/miso-sushi-guilty-face.jpg
Omar: his face when you say the word "walk" is the same face he'd make if offered sushi again 60d
Cal: can we add a lunchbox lock to the kitchen or do we just keep enabling this behavior forever
Tia: i vote enable. he's an ambassador for morale. also i'm ordering extra bento tomorrow to replace my roll :sushi:
Rina: thank you! officecare, pls add "secure lunches" to weekly checklist and file any bribery under "team wellness"
PetBot: Checklist updated: weekly kitchen audit added
Omar: also can we have "Miso cameo" on next all-hands? puppet stage optional
Rina: yes. he'll wear the tiny bandana. highly trained in thievery and posing."
